verdict.rationale: Loops exposes a workflow API to create/update workflow graphs and trigger published workflows via events (loops-docs-27), and markets building onboarding/winback workflows around product events (loops-docs-30, loops-docs-15), which supports automated recurring lifecycle sends. However, this is event-triggered automation rather than explicit time-based/cron-style recurring job scheduling, and there's no documentation of a scheduler primitive for arbitrary recurring jobs beyond email lifecycle workflows. Missing for 10: explicit time-based/cron scheduling API, examples of recurring non-email job automation, and independent confirmation that workflows run reliably long-term.
